no evidence here establishes whether the broader position reduced fighting."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d35e109054e21846","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 21 March 2023, Xi and Putin signed a joint statement calling for Ukraine peace talks, responsible dialogue, avoidance of escalation and protracted fighting, and respect for international law and the UN Charter.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; They created rules on lawful training data, privacy, intellectual property, discrimination, transparency, content controls, security assessments, complaints, supervision, reporting, and penalties including service suspension.","question_ids":["1B.9","4B.9","5B.4","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023;
